stemMd: A pattern repeats the block 1, 0, 0, 1, 0. What is the sum of its first 23 entries?
explanationMd: Each five-entry block sums to two. The first twenty entries contain four blocks, summing to eight. The remaining three entries are 1,0,0, adding one. Total is nine.

distractorRationale.a: This counts only four full blocks and ignores the remaining initial one.
distractorRationale.c: This counts a fifth complete block although only three entries of it are present.
distractorRationale.d: This overcounts the ones in the partial block.
distractorRationale.e: Most entries are zero, so the sum is not the entry count.
